purpose: Phase-2 exploratory Dr.GRPO cohort (plan §2-3, proposal rlvr-method-plan ACCEPTED by user 2026-07-02, unlocked by Phase-1 GO: sft pass@8 = 7%/10% on gsm8k/math_l13): ONE Dr.GRPO seed + the REQUIRED random-reward spurious gate + the iso-generation-compute RFT control, all from checkpoint_sft_seed0.pt.
base_ckpt: Qwen3-0.6B/experiments/2026-06-27_qwen3-0.6b_sft-3seed/checkpoint_sft_seed0.pt (policy init AND frozen k3-KL reference, strict load)

arms: grpo (Dr.GRPO: mean-center no-std, token-level global-mean, DAPO dynamic sampling, clip 0.2, k3-KL beta 3e-3 INFERRED)
random (identical pipeline, Bernoulli(0.5) content-blind reward — Spurious Rewards gate, REQUIRED §C25)
rft (same 300x16xG=8 rollout budget from FROZEN policy, keep verifier-correct, masked-SFT lr 1e-5 INFERRED)

single_variable: grpo-vs-random isolates the REWARD SIGNAL (identical rollouts config, updates, budget); grpo-vs-rft isolates on-policy advantage vs best-of-n SFT at iso-generation-compute. seed_ci NOT satisfiable at n=1 -> verdict capped directional BY DESIGN (pre-registered; the 3-seed CI cohort is Phase 3, off-box propose-only).
recipe: 300 steps x 16 prompts x G=8 @ T=0.8 cap 256 (grpo-math-prompts-v1 clean: 7471 gsm8k + 3490 math_l13, 2:1 mix), reward = pinned math-acc-v1 verifier (1.0 correct / 0.1 parseable-wrong / 0.0 unparseable), AdamW lr 1e-6 (rft 1e-5), grad clip 1.0, no KV cache (exact full-prefix re-forward; vLLM broken on sm_121), per-token tensor math ORACLE-GATED vs posttrain_losses every 50 steps (abort on >1e-3 mismatch).

smoke.detail: §C5.0 all three arms 1 step (4 prompts x G=4, cap 128): rollouts finite, rewards in {0,0.1,1}/{Bernoulli}, DAPO kept 2/4 groups (grpo), advantages finite, k3-KL exactly 0 at init (policy==ref, correct), oracle check pass, ckpt save + exit 0. Smoke ckpts DELETED before launch (would contaminate --resume).

probe.peak_mem_note: policy+ref bf16 ~2.4GB + per-micro-batch fp32 logits <=8x~400xV ~1.9GB — far under the 0.83 kill line; rollout KV-free

verdict_metric: PAIRED decision-metric eval on the Phase-1 band (same 150 items, seed 20260701, same math-acc-v1 extractor): pass@1 Wilson + pass@8 per arm vs the Phase-1 sft_seed0 floor (gsm8k 1.1%/7%, math_l13 1.5%/10%). SPURIOUS GATE: grpo must beat BOTH controls (random ~= grpo -> elicitation, refuse). Plus §C13 forgetting probe (BPB wikitext2+code vs SFT floor), verifier FP-rate diagnostic, grpo_health (reward/KL/kept-groups/length from health_*.jsonl). Expected honest outcome per plan: null-to-tiny delta that the gate correctly refuses to call a win; verdict cap = directional (n=1).
